name: francis-pwavwe-portfolio
description: Futuristic TypeScript portfolio for Francis Pwavwe

scripts.lint:studio: npm --prefix apps/build run lint && npm --prefix functions-build run lint
scripts.typecheck:studio: npm --prefix apps/build run typecheck && npm --prefix functions-build run typecheck
scripts.test:studio: npm --prefix apps/build run test && npm --prefix functions-build run test
scripts.test:studio:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-francis-pwavwe --only firestore "npm --prefix apps/build run test:rules:run"
scripts.build:studio:all: npm run build:studio && npm --prefix functions-build run build
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run build:studio && firebase deploy --only hosting:build
scripts.deploy:studio:backend: npm --prefix functions-build run build && firebase deploy --only functions:build,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
